attributes.additional_details:
This petition will allow kids aged between 14-15 to be able to get a motorcycle restricted to 50cc max.
They will also have restrictions such as no passengers no night riding and they’re not allowed on motorways.
They will also have to put something in their bike to show other drives that they’re on a permit. But it’s different for people aged 14-15 than 16+ like for 14-15 they can have a different color P to show others their a permit rider and to show others they’re a permit rider.
attributes.background:
Want the government to allow kids that are between the ages 14-15 to be eligible for a motorcycle permit license.
This would be very good because it would make kids go out more rather than staying inside all day.
It’s also a better way for parents to connect with their children.

rejection.details:
We have a petition on this subject already open which you may wish to sign:

Allow people aged 14-15 to be able to get a motorcycle permit license
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/781338
